Title: Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline
Content: List of Contents Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline Use Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline - Extend or trim the Internal Line to Pattern outline. - Right-click on the Internal Line and select Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline from the pop-up menu. Use Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline - Use the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Pattern tool to right click on the Internal Line - Select Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline from the pop-up menu. - The selected Internal Line will extend or trim to the Pattern outline.

Title: Edit Grading Properties
Content: List of Contents Grading Properties Select Pattern with Grading Edit Grading Properties Grading Properties - Edit grading rules applied to the selected Pattern. - Main Menu 2D Pattern Grading - 2D Toolbar Grading Select Pattern with Grading - Click on the Pattern outline or point which its grading rule to be edited. - Selected Pattern outline or points grading properties appear in the Property Editor. - If there is no applied grading rule on the selected Pattern outline or point, an error message appears alerting No graded size available to edit. Edit Grading Properties Distance Edit selected Pattern outline or points grading rules. Use the Distance option to assign each Sizes distance apart from its Base Size. Size All Sizes belong to the applied Size Group appear. X-Axis Shift the Size on X-axis. Y-Axis Shift the Size on Y-axis. Offset Edit selected Pattern outline or points grading rules. Use the Offset option to edit distance between each size. Size All Sizes belong to the applied Size Group appear. X-Axis Shift the Size on X-axis. Y-Axis Shift the Size on Y-axis. All Edit all Offset values at once(ver4.1.0). Arrow Key Movement Assign the distance to be moved when using arrow keys.

Title: Duplicate as Mirrored Internal Line
Content: Objective Mirror paste Pattern Outline or Internal Line to compare with original Pattern Outlines before the edit. Location Right Click (On Pattern Outline or Internal Line) Duplicate as Mirrored Internal Line Operation Select the Edit Pattern tool. Follow the path indicated below: Right Click (On Pattern Outline or Internal Line) Duplicate as Mirrored Internal Line A guide appears for you to select a reference line which the selected Pattern Outline or the Internal Line to be mirror based accordingly. Hover the mouse over the reference line. The reference line turns light blue. A preview appears where the mirrored Pattern Outline or Internal Line will be duplicated to. Select the desired reference line. The Pattern Outline or the Internal Line is duplicated based on the selected reference line. The duplicated Internal Line belongs to the Pattern selected in step 2.

Title: Create Buttons along Pattern Outline
Content: List of Contents Create Select Unlink Objective Create buttons along a Pattern Outline in a constant interval and distance.. Location Main Menu Materials Button Button 3D toolbar Button Operation Create Select the tool/menu indicated. Right-click on the outline or internal line of the pattern. The button/buttonhole creation option window appears along the pattern outline. Note: Hold down the Shift key and left-click on a segment to select multiple. Set each option and click OK. Type Start Position Repeatedly create a button based on the starting point. Distribute Create by aligning buttons at regular intervals between the starting and ending points. Based on Start Start Position Distance Adjust the distance between the clicked segment and the center of the button. Interval Adjust the spacing between the pattern outline and the center of the button. Reverse The starting point of the button and replicated created direction are adjusted in reverse. Replicate Interval Adjust the distance between the buttons. Number of Buttons/Buttonholes Adjust the number of buttons. Distribute Position Distance Adjust the distance between the clicked segment and t he center of the button. Start/End Interval Adjust the spacing between the pattern outline and the center of the start/end buttons. Replicate Number of Buttons/Buttonholes Enter the number of buttons/buttonholes to align between the start and end points. A group button is created. Select Select the tool/menu indicated. Click a button or segment created along the pattern outline. All grouped buttons are selected. Change the button properties and style or right-click. Applied to grouped buttons. Group information is not copied/pasted. Note: If clicking again on the selected group button, it is able to select a button individually. Grouped buttons cannot be moved. Unlink Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. After right-clicking on a button or segment created along the pattern outline and click Unlink Buttons/Buttonholes. The group is unlinked.

Title: Show Pattern Annotations
Content: List of Contents Show Pattern Annotations Importing DXF File With Annotations Show/hide Pattern Annotations Show Pattern Annotations - Show or hide Pattern Annotations from the 2D Window. - Select the Show Pattern Annotations tool from the 2D toolbar. - Or, right click on the 2D Window to access the pop-up menu. Select SHOW PATTERN ANNOTATIONS. Importing DXF File with Annotations - To import annotations along with DXF file, check on IMPORT PATTERN ANNOTATION option in the Import DXF Window. Show/Hide Pattern Annotations - When Pattern Annotation tool is in use, Show Pattern Annotations tool is activated by default. - To show Pattern Annotations while using other tools, select the Select/Move Pattern Annotation tool from the 2D toolbar. - Hidden Pattern Annotations will appear again in the 2D Window.

Title: 2D Snapshot (1:1)
Content: Objective Save real size 2D pattern (1:1). Location Main Menu File Snapshot 2D Pattern (1:1) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Snapshot 2D Pattern (1:1) 2D window is enlarged, 2D Snapshot window appears. Set below details as needed. Locate the patterns according to the selected setting size (paper), Click Save. Size Preset Customize or select from provided preset options. Orientation Select from portrait or landscape orientation options. Resolution Sets the pixels per inch for the image. Options Fabric Image View or hide the fabric image. Graphic Image View or hide the graphic image. Reset Resets the options back to the program default settings. In order to save the file, enter desired file name and location, then click Save. The image can be saved in .png or .pdf file format. Note: Now you can select segments with the Edit Pattern tool and the selected segments will be highlighted in the 2D Snapshot image (ver3.2.0). Prior to saving the 2D Snapshot image, you can now arrange patterns with the Transform Pattern tool (ver3.2.0). Save the image background as transparent (ver3.2.0). Toggle symmetry, instance, trims, and measurements for graphics on or off (ver3.2.0). 2D snapshots can only be saved as .png format in ver4.0.0 and below.

Title: Internal Ellipse
Content: List of Contents Create Internal Ellipse Create Internal Ellipse with Entered Values Objective Create internal ellipses or circles within Patterns. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Ellipse 2D Toolbar Internal Ellipse Operation Create Internal Ellipse Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Ellipse 2D Toolbar Internal Ellipse Click and drag within a Pattern to freehand an ellipse. Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to create a circle. Note: While creating the Internal Shape, press down the Ctrl key on the keyboard to create it by the center point (ver.5.1.0). While creating the Internal Shape, press down the Shift + Ctrl keys to create a full circle by its center point (ver.5.1.0). Release the mouse to complete the Internal Ellipse or the Internal Circle. Create Internal Ellipse with Entered Values Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Ellipse 2D Toolbar Internal Ellipse Click once within a Pattern. The Create Ellipse window appears. Enter the desired values. Diameter Set the diameter of the Internal Circle. Radius Set the radius of the Internal Circle (ver3.2.0). Link to maintain the width and height ratio. Circumference Set the circumference of the Internal Circle (ver3.2.0). Position To Outline Set the position of the left, right, top, and bottom of the Internal Circles from the Pattern outline (ver2.5.0). To Center Set the position of the center of the Internal Circle from the left, right, top, and bottom of the Pattern outline (ver2.5.0).

Title: Add Perpendicular Internal Line
Content: List of Contents Add from a Point Add from a Segment Objective Create Internal Lines perpendicular to Pattern outlines or 2D window. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Operation Add from a Point Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Right click on the point of a Pattern outline or Internal Line. The right-click pop-up menu appears. Hover the mouse over the Add Perpendicular Internal Line option. Below options appear. X-Axis Can type in Internal Line's angle based on 2D window's X-axis. Y-Axis Can type in Internal Line's angle based on 2D window's Y-axis. Local Can type in Internal Line's angle based on the selected segment. Select the desired option. The Add Perpendicular Internal Line window with different options appears based on your selection. Option Description X-Axis/ Y-Axis Local (Pattern outline) Local (Internal Line) Angle Type in the angle for the Internal Line. As the default angle is 90º, you may easily create Internal Line perpendicularly. Length Type in Internal Line's length. Extend When the option is toggled on, the Internal Line extends to Pattern outlines. When the Length value is different from the length when it is extended, the option turns off automatically. Both (ver5.0.0) Add Internal Line on both sides of the selected point. Opposite Segment Not Applicable Internal Line is created based on the other side of the selected line. Reverse Not Applicable The Internal Line is reversed. Add from a Segment Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Right click on the Pattern outline or Internal Line. The right-click pop-up menu appears. Select Add Perpendicular Internal Line. The Internal Line preview appears at the center of the selected Pattern outline or Internal Line. The Add Perpendicular Internal Line window appears. Configure below options as needed and click OK. Option Description Angle Type in the angle for the Internal Line. As the default angle is 90º, you may easily create Internal Line perpendicularly. Length Type in the length of the Internal Line. Distance to Segment Edge Locate the Internal Line. The Internal Line preview shifts as number changes. Extend When the option is toggled on, the Internal Line extends to Pattern outlines. When the Length value is different from the length when it is extended, the option turns off automatically. Both (ver5.0.0) Add Internal Line on both sides of the selected line. Reverse The Internal Line is reversed. The Internal Line is created accordingly.

Title: Internal Polygon/Line
Content: Objective Create Internal Polygons and Lines inside a Pattern. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Polygon/Line 2D Toolbar Internal Polygon/Line Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Polygon/Line 2D Toolbar Internal Polygon/Line Click within a Pattern to establish the start point of an Internal Polygon/Line. Drag the mouse and click as needed to freehand the Internal Polygon/Line. Right click while freehanding the Internal Polygon/Line to access the Create Internal Polygon/Line window. Use Length, Mirror Creation, and Position options to create the Internal Polygon/Line more precisely and conveniently. Option Description Length Length Designate the length to be created next. When the Mirror Creation option is active, the Length will be applied to the mirrored line as well. Option (ver5.0.0) Mirror Creating The Internal Polygon/Line is created symmetrically. The starting point converts to a closed point. Axis Local Symmetric lines are created based on the starting point (local). X-Axis Symmetric lines are created based on the X-Axis. Y-Axis Symmetric lines are created based on the Y-Axis. Position Left Set the distance between the Internal Polygon/Line and the Pattern outline on its left. Right Set the distance between the Internal Polygon/Line and the Pattern outline on its right. Top Set the distance between the Internal Polygon/Line and the Pattern outline on its top. Bottom Set the distance between the Internal Polygon/Line and the Pattern outline on its bottom. To complete an Internal Polygon, click the start point. On the other hand, to complete an Internal Line, double click the last point. Note: Right click inside a Pattern to open the Create Internal Polygon window and type in desired values. An Internal Polygon is created with the designated values (ver2.5.0). Click inside a Pattern to create the start point of an Internal Line. Then, drag and right click to open the Create Internal Polygon window. Enter desired values. An Internal Line is created with the designated values (ver2.5.0). Hold down the Ctrl key as creating an Internal Polygon/Line to create curves. Hold down the Shift key to drag the mouse in straight lines or in 45º diagonal lines.

Title: Preview and Select AI Artboards
Content: List of Contents Preview and Select AI Artboards Add Graphic Preview and Select AI Artboards - When the AI file imported as a graphic has multiple artboards, preview and select the one in need. - Navigate to the Main Menu and select Materials Graphics Graphic (2D/3D) - Or, select the Graphic (2D/ 3D) tool from the 2D or 3D toolbar. Add Graphic 3D Window - Select the Graphic (3D Pattern) tool from the 3D toolbar. - Choose the AI file to be imported. - When the selected AI file has multiple artboards, the Preview window appears allowing you to select the desired artboard. - After the artboard is selected, the Add Graphic window appears, allowing you to adjust the graphic size. Width - Set the width of the graphic. Height - Set the height of the graphic. - Click OK to complete. 2D Window - Select the Graphic (2D Pattern) tool from the 2D toolbar. - Choose the AI file to be imported. - When the selected AI file has multiple artboards, the Preview window appears allowing you to select the desired artboard. - After the artboard is selected, the Add Graphic window appears, allowing you to adjust the graphic size. Width - Set the width of the graphic. Height - Set the height of the graphic. Outline - Locate the graphic by assigning the margin between the Pattern outline and the graphic outline. Center - Locate the graphic by assigning the distance between the Pattern outline and the center of the graphic. - Click OK to complete.

Title: Copy/Paste Patterns (3D)
Content: Objective Copy and paste patterns in the 3D window. Location Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Copy or Paste Operation Select the Select/Move tool from the 3D toolbar. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Copy or Paste A preview of the copied pattern follows the mouse cursor. Click on the desired location in the 3D window to place the duplicated pattern. The copied pattern is automatically assigned a number. Note: To copy and paste more efficiently, select the pattern, press Ctrl+C, then press Ctrl+V or Ctrl+R on the keyboard to copy, paste or mirror paste, respectively. Copy and paste patterns in the 3D window to another CLO software window (ver3.0.0). This is only available in Windows. Trims and buttons are also copied and pasted along with Patterns (ver5.0.0.) In the case of buttons and/or subsidiary materials in the pattern, they cannot be copied and pasted into other programs.

Title: Perpendicular Pattern Corner (ver 6.1)
Content: Objective Adjust pattern corners to be perpendicular in curved patterns such as armholes and the center front rise of the pants. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Operation Select the tool/menu indicated. Right-click the point of the corner to be set as perpendicular then select Perpendicular Pattern Corner from the right-click menu. The pop-up window appears. After setting the options, click the OK Button. Length Input the length of the segment to be perpendicular to the opposite segment. Direction Set the direction as perpendicular. Note: The number of curve points can be increased to maintain the curvature of the original pattern. At this time, optimize the number of curve points as needed.

Title: Copy/Duplicate Graphic Image
Content: List of Contents Copy/Paste Graphic Image Duplicate Graphic Image Objective Copy/paste or duplicate graphic images as needed. Location Right-click Graphics Pop-up Menu Copy (Ctrl + C), Paste (Ctrl + V) / Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern Operation Copy/Paste Graphic Image Select a graphic image with Edit Texture tool or Transform Graphic tool in the 2D window. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-click Graphics Pop-up Menu Copy (Ctrl + C), Paste (Ctrl + V) The copied graphic image is now being followed on the mouse. Place the copied graphic image at a desired location in the 2D window. Duplicate Graphic Image (ver2.3.0) Select a graphic image with Edit Texture tool or Transform Graphic tool in the 2D window. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-click Graphics Pop-up Menu Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern The selected graphic image is now being duplicated to Symmetric Pattern. Note: Duplicate Graphic Image can only be used on Symmetrical Patterns.

Title: 2D Pattern - Exporting Patterns from Gerber(Gerber Pattern Design)
Content: Objective Export patterns as a DXF file from Gerber in order to use them in CLO. Operation Load the pattern to be exported, and click File Export. Click on the patterns to be exported. Upon clicking the pattern, the Export window will open up, as shown below. Set the File Type to Amma (*.dxf) and press the Options button on the bottom. Check all the sections and press OK. When a window like the one shown below appears, press OK to continue. Ensure that there are no irregularities in the exported pattern, and press Close to complete the export.

Title: Layer Clone
Content: Objective Create an instance of the Pattern in its 3D state while sewing its Pattern outlines and Internal Lines to its instance's Pattern outlines and Internal Lines. Use the function to easily create padded jackets, collars, cuffs and other garments/details made with multiple layers of Patterns. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu Layer Clone (Over/Under) Operation Select Transform Pattern tool or Edit Pattern tool. Select the Patterns to be layer cloned. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu Layer Clone (Over) The cloned Pattern is placed above the original Pattern. Right Click Pop-Up Menu Layer Clone (Under) The cloned Pattern is placed beneath the original Pattern. Activate Simulation. The cloned layer is simulated based on the option selected.

Title: Set Sublayer (Pattern)
Content: Objective In the 2D window, set an order between two selected Patterns to achieve stable simulation for a 3D Garment with multiple layers such as windbreaker, utilitarian jacket, and more. Location 3D Toolbar Set Sublayer Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Set Sublayer Only Pattern outlines appear in the 2D window. Click a Pattern to be arranged on top. The selected Pattern's outline turns red and a red arrow follows along the mouse cursor. Click another Pattern that should be arranged below the first Pattern clicked. A black arrow is created connecting two selected Patterns. A plus sign appears at the center of the arrow to indicate the order of two Patterns. To change the order between two Patterns, use the same tool and select the plus sign. The plus sign changes to a minus sign and the Pattern order is changed.

Title: Add Perpendicular Internal Lines
Content: List of Contents Add Perpendicular Internal Lines Add From a Point Add From a Line Add Perpendicular Internal Lines - Create Internal Lines perpendicular to selected Pattern outline or point, or perpendicular to X or Y axis of 2D window. - Select the Edit Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. - Right click on the point where an Internal Line should be added and select Add Perpendicular Internal Line. Add From a Point X-Axis - The Add Perpendicular Internal Line window appears. - Configure Angle and Length of the Internal Line based on the X axis - To extend the Internal Line to the Pattern outline, please toggle on Extend option. Note: To add the Internal Line opposite from current direction, toggle on Reverse option. Y-Axis - The Add Perpendicular Internal Line window appears. - Configure Angle and Length of the Internal Line based on the Y axis. - To extend the Internal Line to the Pattern outline, please toggle on Extend option. Note: To add the Internal Line opposite from current direction, toggle on Reverse option. Local - The Add Perpendicular Internal Line window appears. - Configure Angle and Length of the Internal Line based on the selected point. - To extend the Internal Line to the Pattern outline, please toggle on Extend option. - To add the Internal Line based on the opposite side of the selected point, toggle on Refer to Opposite Segment. Note: To add the Internal Line opposite from current direction, toggle on Reverse option. Add From a Line X-Axis - The Add Perpendicular Internal Line window appears. - Configure Angle and Length of the Internal Line based on the X axis and its Distance to Segment Edge. - To extend the Internal Line to the Pattern outline, please toggle on Extend option. - When the Length value is different from the length when it is extended, the option turns off automatically. Note: To add the Internal Line opposite from current direction, toggle on Reverse option. Y-Axis - The Add Perpendicular Internal Line window appears. - Configure Angle and Length of the Internal Line based on the Y axis and its Distance to Segment Edge. - To extend the Internal Line to the Pattern outline, please toggle on Extend option. - When the Length value is different from the length when it is extended, the option turns off automatically. Note: To add the Internal Line opposite from current direction, toggle on Reverse option. Local - The Add Perpendicular Internal Line window appears. - Configure Angle and Length of the Internal Line based on the selected segment and its Distance to Segment Edge. - To extend the Internal Line to the Pattern outline, please toggle on Extend option. - When the Length value is different from the length when it is extended, the option turns off automatically. Note: To add the Internal Line opposite from current direction, toggle on Reverse option.

Title: Hi/Low-Resolution Garment
Content: Objective Enhance or lower the resolution of Garments. Use this function to enhance the Garment completion in order to emphasize reality and higher quality of a Garment and on the other hand, reduce it for faster adjustments. Location Main Menu 3D Garment Hi-Res Garment / Low-Res Garment 3D Toolbar Hi-Res Garment / Low-Res Garment Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Hi-Res Garment / Low-Res Garment 3D Toolbar Hi-Res Garment / Low-Res Garment Hi/Low-Res Properties window appears. Adjust the value for each item. Garment Particle Distance Sets the Particle Distance value applying to all Patterns. - Hi-Res Garment default value: 5mm - Low-Res Garment default value: 20mm Tolerance Applies only for Patterns within the range of application of Particle Distance. The default tolerance value is between 5mm ~ 20mm, and any Pattern within the range set above is going to be applied. Note: This is provided to maintain the particle distance value of small patterns below 5mm for more stable simulation. Being mindful of the tolerance can avoid unintentional changes to these patterns. Add'l Thickness - Collision Sets the collision thickness value applying to all patterns. - Hi-Res Garment default value: 1mm - Low-Res Garment default value: 2.5mm Tolerance Any Pattern within the range set above is going to be applied. Avatar Skin Offset Sets the skin offset value applying to avatar. - Hi-Res Garment default value: 0mm - Low-Res Garment default value: 3mm Tolerance Any Avatar within the range set above is going to be applied. Simulation Simulation Quality Sets the simulation quality as Complete or Normal. - Hi-Res Garment default value: Complete - Low-Res Garment default value: Normal Note: Set the simulation quality on Complete for material properties generated in Emulator Mode to result the most accurate simulation. However it may slow down the simulation speed therefore it is recommended to apply this setting when enhancing the garment completion. Check On/Off Menus Toggle option whether to apply on Garment, Avatar, Simulation settings. Click OK button. The adjustments are now being applied. Activate the Simulation. The adjustments are now being applied to Garment Simulation.

Title: Offset Pattern Outline
Content: Objective Extend (ver3.0.0) or retract (ver5.1.0) the Pattern outline while maintaining its original shape. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu Offset Pattern Outline Operation With the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Pattern tool, select the entire or partial Pattern outline. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu Offset Pattern Outline The Offset Pattern Outline Window appears. Adjust following options as needed. Option Description Direction (ver5.1.0) Extend Extend Pattern Outlines. Retract Retract Pattern Outlines. Note: Only Distance can be modified when Retract is selected. Distance Set how much in distance the Pattern outline is extended. Number of Offsets Set the number of offsets to be created. Total Distance Total Distance = Distance x Number of Offsets Create Internal Line Create Internal Lines at where the original Pattern outlines existed. Side Segment Type Perpendicular Extends the Pattern outline perpendicular to the selected Pattern outline. Extend Side Segments (ver3.0.0) Extends the Pattern outline while matching the angles of the segments on either side. Mirror (ver5.0.0) Extends the Pattern outline based on the corner angle created with the selected Pattern outline and its adjacent one. Default Corner Extends the Pattern outline all around the selected segment or Pattern. Right Angled Corner Extends the Pattern outline all around the selected segment or Pattern and converting corners to right angles. Unfilled Corner Extends the Pattern outline all around the selected segment or pattern, except for corners. Click OK. The Pattern outlines are offset according to the settings. Curve points are optimized automatically. (ver 5.2)

Title: 2D Pattern - Exporting Patterns from Yuka(SuperALPHA: Plus Yuka Pattern CAD System)
Content: Objective Export patterns as a DXF file from Yuka in order to use them in CLO. Note: Things to Check Before Exporting Patterns Confirm that patterns are closed shapes and all segments are connected. Patterns must be closed in order to virtualize them in the 3D environment. Confirm that patterns are not intersecting each other. If patterns' light blue bounding boxes are intersecting, the overlapped area will not be exported properly. Operation DXF-AAMA Export Follow the indicated guideline below: File EXPORT Set TIIP/AAMA (exps) In the Set DXF Export windows Pattern Outer lines only check Margins (Cutting Lines) only. Set the CAD type as Etc. and press OK. Follow the indicated guideline below: File EXPORT Set TIIP/AAMA (exp) In the Export DXF windows File Type check AAMA. After setting whether or not the pattern has any margins in Print Pattern Classification, click the Entire Area on the right. Press Reference on the Designate Export window to set the path to export the DXF and click OK. If a warning window saying There is a warning pattern pops up, click OK first and then check the patterns status on the window that appears afterwards. If all the patterns appear as OK then proceed to click OK to finish. If there are any that appear as NG find them and fix the problem. Patterns may have problems when outer and sewing lines are swapped.

Title: Spiral Pattern (ver 6.1)
Content: Objective Create a Spiral pattern in a 2D window. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Spiral 2D Toolbar Spiral Operation Select the tool/menu indicated. Click the 2D window. The Create Spiral Window appears. After setting the options below, click OK. Radius Set the radius at which a spiral pattern rotates. Length Set the length of the inner/outer segment of the spiral pattern. Side Set the inside/outside width of the spiral pattern. Offset Adjust the spacing between spirals. The length you enter is the distance from the center of the spiral pattern to the center of the next spiral layer. Direction Set the rotation direction (clockwise/counterclockwise) of the spiral pattern. A spiral pattern is created.

Title: Hide All 3D Patterns
Content: Hide All 3D Patterns - Hide all Patterns in the 3D window. - Right-click on the 3D window and select Hide All 3D Patterns from the pop-up menu. - All Patterns in the 3D Window will be hidden. - To show all Patterns, right click on the 3D window and select Show All 3D Patterns from the pop-up menu.

Title: Extend/Trim & Add Point to Pattern Outline
Content: List of Contents Extend/Trim &amp Add Point to Pattern Outline Use Extend/Trim &amp Add Point to Pattern Outline Extend/Trim &amp Add Point to Pattern Outline - Add point to the Pattern outline while extending or trimming the Internal Line. - Right-click on the Internal Line and select Extend/Trim &amp Add Point to Pattern Outline from the pop-up menu. Use Extend/Trim &amp Add Point to Pattern Outline - Use the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Pattern tool to right click on the Internal Line - Select Extend/Trim &amp Add Point to Pattern Outline from the pop-up menu. - The selected Internal Line will extend or trim to the Pattern outline while points are added.

Title: 2D Pattern (AI/PDF) Import/Export
Content: List of Contents Import Adobe (AI/PDF) Import (Add) Adobe (AI/PDF) Export Adobe (PDF) Objective Import Adobe (AI/PDF) formatted patterns into CLO, and export patterns created in CLO as a PDF file. Location Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) Main Menu File Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) Import (Add) Adobe (AI/ PDF) Main Menu Import (Add) Adobe (AI/ PDF) Export Adobe (PDF) Main Menu File Export Adobe (PDF) Operation Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) The Open File window appears. Select the desired file to be imported and click OK. The Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) window appears. Adjust the settings as needed and select OK. Note: Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) Options Scale Select the unit used in AI. Rotation Rotate all patterns as importing them. Option (Import as Baseline) All shapes encompassed within their outer shape (pattern) will be imported as baselines. Option (Import as Internal Shapes) All shapes encompassed within their outer shape (pattern) will be imported as internal shapes (ver3.1.0). Option (Import as Graphic) All shapes/images encompasses within their outer shape (pattern) will be imported as graphics (ver3.1.0). Open shapes with color information will be imported as graphics as well (ver3.1.0). Import (Add) Adobe (AI/ PDF) Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Import (Add) Adobe (AI/ PDF) The Open File window appears. As setting Import Adobe (AI/PDF) options, adjust Import (Add) Adobe (AI/PDF) options as needed. Export Adobe (PDF) Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Export Adobe (PDF) The Save File window appears. Type in the file name and designate the path the file is exported to. The Export PDF window appears. Adjust Scale and Rotation, and then click OK. The patterns will be exported as a PDF file.

Title: Hide 3D Pattern
Content: Hide 3D Pattern Hide 3D Pattern Hide All 3D Patterns Hide 3D Pattern - Hide 3D Patterns from the 3D window at your convenience. - Select the Select/Move tool from the 3D toolbar. Right-click on the Patterns in the 3D window and select Hide 3D Pattern from the pop-up menu. The selected Patterns will be hidden from the 3D window. - The hidden Pattern cannot be selected nor moved in the 3D window. Hide All 3D Patterns - Hide All 3D Patterns from the 3D window at your convenience. - Select the Select/Move tool from the 3D toolbar. Right-click on the Patterns in the 3D window and select Hide All 3D Pattern from the pop-up menu. All Patterns will be hidden from the 3D window.

Title: Delete All Pins on Selected Patterns
Content: Delete All Pins on Selected Patterns - Delete pins on each Pattern. - Choose the Select/Move tool from the 3D toolbar. Navigate to the 3D window and right click on the 3D Garment, and then select pin Delete All Pins on Selected Patterns. - All pins created on the selected Pattern will be deleted.

Title: Edit Pattern Symbol Properties
Content: List of Contents Pattern Symbol Edit Properties Pattern Symbol - Modify created Pattern Symbols as needed. - Main Menu 2D Pattern Pattern Annotation Pattern Symbol or Edit Annotation. - 2D Toolbar Pattern Symbol or Edit Annotation. Edit Properties - Click the Pattern Symbol to be edited. - Selected Pattern Symbols properties appear in the Property Editor. Name Rename selected Pattern Symbol. Line Type Select the Shape of the Pattern Symbol. Flip This option only appears when a Pattern Symbol is added to an Internal Line. Pattern Symbol is flipped to the other side of the selected Internal Line.

Title: Pattern Instruction Lines
Content: List of Contents Pattern Symbol Create Pattern Symbol Select Pattern Symbol Delete Pattern Symbol Pattern Symbol - Create, select, and delete instruction lines on Patterns to guide construction. - Navigate to the Main Menu and select 2D Pattern Pattern Annotation Pattern Symbol. - Select the Pattern Symbol tool from the 2D toolbar. Create Pattern Symbol Create a Single Pattern Symbol - Hover the mouse over the Pattern outline or Internal Line where the Pattern Symbol should be created. - The segment is highlighted in light-blue. - Click on the segment to create the symbol. - The Place on Fold 1 symbol is created by default. Create Multiple Pattern Symbols - To create more than one Pattern Symbols on multiple Pattern outlines or Internal Lines, select all desired segments while holding down the Shift key on the keyboard. - You may also click and drag on the 2D window or use the Lasso Selection to select multiple segments. Select Pattern Symbol - Select the Pattern outline or the Internal Line where the Pattern Symbol is created. - The Pattern Symbol is selected as its highlighted in yellow. - To select all Pattern Symbols, hold down the Ctrl + A keys at the same time. Delete Pattern Symbol - To delete the Pattern Symbol, select and hit the Delete key on the keyboard. - Or, right click on the Pattern Symbol to be deleted and select Delete from the pop-up menu.

Title: AI Import of Patterns with Prints/Graphics Applied
Content: List of Contents Import Adobe (AI/PDF) Importing Patterns with Prints/Graphics Import - Adobe (AI/PDF) - AI Patterns with graphics can be imported into CLO together, without having to import them separately. - Navigate to Main Menu Import ADOBE (AI/PDF). Importing Patterns with Prints/Graphics - Navigate to Main Menu Import ADOBE (AI/PDF). A file browser to select AI file will appear. Select the AI file to be imported. - The Import AI/PDF pop-up window will appear. - Toggle on Import as Internal Shape and Import as Graphic. - Adjust related options in the Import AI/PDF pop-up window and select OK. - The selected AI file will be imported with Prints/Graphics and each item can be edited individually.

Title: Create Multiple Patterns or Internal Shapes and Input Intervals
Content: Objective Designate the number of shapes and input the interval when creating Patterns or Internal Lines. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Applicable Tools 2D Toolbar Applicable Tools Note: Applicable tools are as follows: Rectangle tool, Internal Rectangle tool, Ellipse tool, Internal Ellipse tool. Operation Follow the indicated guideline as below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Applicable Tools 2D Toolbar Applicable Tools Click once on the 2D window. The pop-up window with options to create the selected Pattern or Internal Shape appears. Enter desired values for options below the Replicate category and click OK. Name Description Number of Shapes Set the number of replicated shapes. Interval Set the distance between each Pattern or Internal Shape/Line. Angle Set the direction that the replicated Patterns are placed. The Patterns or Internal Shapes/Lines are replicated based on the settings.
